Suche Erweiterte Suche QA Engineer (Mid/Senior) ❮ zurück zur letzten Suche Talon.One Berlin 1000 per year Vollzeit BALDIGER BEWERBUNGSSCHLUSS Auf diesen Job bewerben ABOUT TALON.ONE: Talon.One, an Adyen company, is the most powerful incentives engine that unifies loyalty, personalized promotions and offer management into a single platform. Built for enterprise scale and security, Talon.One helps businesses design and deliver incentives that drive real customer behavior. Today, over 300 of the world’s most-loved brands including Sephora, Gymshark and Costa Coffee work with Talon.One to turn their incentives into a reliable growth engine. ABOUT THE TEAM: Our Research and Development department is made up of cross-functional teams of Developers, Interaction Designers, QA Engineers, and Documentation specialists, all collaborating under the guidance of Product and Engineering Managers. Each team owns a specific area of our platform. We work with relative autonomy, encourage original ideas, foster professional growth, and believe that quality at every stage is of utmost importance. We’re looking for a QA Engineer who will be an advocate for quality from the very start of the development process. In this role, you’ll collaborate closely with all functions to shape testing strategies, ask the right questions early, and ensure that robust test coverage exists as features are developed. Rather than merely focusing on testing completed changes, you’ll embed quality into our development process, championing best practices, improving test automation, and ensuring that great software is continuously delivered. ONCE YOU ARE HERE YOU WILL: Become an expert in the Talon.One product, and the foremost expert in the area for which your team is responsible. Collaborate with product, design, and engineering functions to ensure our delivered features are consistently of a high quality. Set the test strategy, engage critically with all functions from the outset of each feature. Ensure we have design and behavioral consistency between features, and strong, efficient test coverage at every level. Determine which test scenarios should be included in our suite of end-to-end automated tests, and implement those using Cypress. Willingness to proactively help junior Quality Engineers, provide timely feedback, and guide them to success. Contribute to Mentorship Programs and onboarding new joiners. WHAT WE NEED YOU TO BRING TO THE TABLE: Ability to communicate effectively and clearly in English, and precisely describe complex interactions Ability to architect a strong Test Strategy Strong track record in advocating for quality at all levels of development process 3 - 6+ years of experience delivering quality web applications with test automation, including REST APIs/GraphQL ABOUT TECHNOLOGY: Kubernetes running on Google Cloud PostgreSQL Golang for our API, core logic, and internal tooling TypeScript, React, Redux, and CSS modules for our web application Cypress for automated end-to-end testing WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU: A Research and Development Department of 100+ of engineers, product managers and product designers in Berlin Leaders with 8+ years of experience building our promotions engine €1,000 annual learning budget and free German language courses to boost your skills 30 days of annual leave, plus extra paid days for your birthday and moving day Home office setup budget, a monthly home office allowance Freedom to work from abroad for up to 90 days worldwide! Mental health support with nilo.health and a discounted Urban Sports Club membership 20% company subsidy on your pension contributions BVG public transport ticket and welcome your furry friend in our dog-friendly Berlin office! Headquartered in San Francisco, our investors include Benchmark , General Catalyst , Peter Thiel , Adam D'Angelo , Larry Summers , and Jack Dorsey . Position: QA / Software Engineering Reviewer – Browser Test Validation Type: Contract Compensation: $30–$60/hour Location: Remote Role Responsibilities Review browser-based testing workflows for AI-generated web applications . Assess technical feasibility and reliability of browser interactions. Validate test isolation, fixtures, setup, and execution flow. Strong experience testing modern web applications. Familiarity with browser automation frameworks such as Playwright , Cypress , Selenium , or similar tools. Excellent debugging skills and attention to detail.
